arabic text: SHAAHE KHURASAN KA ATA JANAZA HAI YE
english translation text: THE FUNERAL OF THE KING OF KHORASAN IS COMING

arabic text: SHAAHE KHURASAN KA ATA JANAZA HAI YE\nPITO SAR AHLE AZA ATA JANAZA HAI YE
english translation text: THE FUNERAL OF THE KING OF KHORASAN IS COMING,\nO LOVERS OF IMAM REZA (A.S.), MOURN AS HIS COFFIN IS APPROACHING

arabic text: FATEMA KE GHAR SE YEH NIKLA YE TABUT HAI\nRO’O AEY AHLE AZA ATA JANAAZA HAI YE
english translation text: THIS FUNERAL HAS COME OUT OF THE HOUSE OF BIBI FATIMA (S.A.),\nTHE LOVERS OF IMAM REZA (A.S.) ARE CRYING, THE COFFIN IS APPROACHING

arabic text: SHEHIE KHURASAN MAI MARE GAYE SHAHEDEEN\nWIRAA MADINA HUWA ATA JANAAZA HAI YE
english translation text: THE UPHOLDER OF THE RELIGION HAS BEEN MARTYRED IN KHORASAN,\nTHE CITY OF MEDINA HAS BECOME DESOLATE, THE COFFIN IS APPROACHING

arabic text: AHLE FALAK SAATH HAIN SAR KHULE JIBRIL HAI\nSHAUR YEHI HAI BAPA ATA JANAAZA HAI YE
english translation text: THE ANGELS ARE HERE AND JIBRAIL IS GRIEVING,\nTHIS IS WHAT IS BEING SAID, THE COFFIN IS APPROACHING

arabic text: MAMUN MALAWN NE ZEHR DIYA SHAH KO\nROTE HAI AAJ MUSTAFA ATA JANAAZA HAI YE
english translation text: MAMOON (THE KING) POISONED THE IMAM (A.S.),\nTHE PROPHET (PBUH) IS WEEPING TODAY, THE COFFIN IS APPROACHING

arabic text: ROTI HAI SAR PIT’TI ZAHRA HAY HAMRAH CHALI\nMATAM KARO SHEH KE BAPA ATA JANAZA HAI YE
english translation text: BIBI ZAHRA (S.A) IS ALSO WEEPING AND WALKING ALONG,\nDO MATAM OF IMAM REZA (A.S.), THE COFFIN IS APPROACHING
